records.summary: Redemptions may require verification, including age and identity checks and, where required, source-of-funds or source-of-wealth documents. The redemption method name must match the Customer Account name.
Before processing, players may need to complete eligibility verification; listed materials include government ID, proof of address, facial verification, and SSN confirmation where required.
Sweepstakes Coins are non-transferable; McLuck allows one Customer Account per person, and activity or balances cannot be moved between accounts to reach a redemption minimum.

To receive a promotional reward, the player must meet eligibility requirements, participate during the promotional period, complete any required purchase or qualifying action, and not have already claimed or used the reward.
MCLUCK4JULY is applied once at registration; the welcome offers appear in order as eligible optional Gold Coin purchases are completed across the first three purchases.

Refer-a-friend rewards require the friend to sign up through the referral link, both accounts to meet eligibility requirements, the friend's qualifying purchase, and all Refer a Friend Terms & Conditions.
The welcome rewards are not available outside the United States of America or in US states where McLuck does not offer services.

Promotion eligibility varies by offer and may require participation requirements, qualifying purchases where applicable, participation during the promotional period, and compliance with the Terms & Conditions.

The operator says it does not offer services in the listed states, outside the United States, and potentially additional supplier-restricted jurisdictions; it says promotional contests are no longer offered in California.

The operator says it or a third party may conduct age, identity, credit-background, and other required verification checks, and may request redacted copies of the payment mechanism used for successful purchases.

The operator says verification documents may include government photo ID, a matching utility bill, and source-of-wealth or source-of-funds documentation; if verification cannot be completed, including if requested documents are not provided within 30 days, it may terminate, deactivate, or restrict the account.

The operator reserves the right to close an account dormant for 60 days or longer without prior notice, and says customer-requested account closure forfeits access to and benefits of associated Virtual Coins.

Promotions, contests, and special offers are subject to the terms, official rules, and additional published terms; promotion-specific terms take precedence, and offers may be exclusive to selected customers with varying eligibility.
